notes.title: Focaccia with olives
notes.html:
Focaccia with olives

One 9×13 pan. Start the night before for the best crumb.

Ingredients
  • 500 g bread flour
  • 400 g warm water
  • 1 packet (7 g) instant yeast
  • 12 g fine sea salt
  • 1 tsp honey
  • 6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided
  • 1 cup mixed olives (Castelvetrano + Kalamata), pitted and halved
  • 2 sprigs fresh rosemary
  • Zest of 1 lemon
  • Flaky sea salt
Method
  1. Whisk the water, honey and yeast. Add the flour and salt and mix until shaggy. No kneading!
  2. Drizzle 2 tbsp oil over the dough, cover, and leave it in the fridge overnight (12–24 hrs).
  3. Coat the pan with 2 tbsp oil. Tip the dough in, fold the edges under, and let it rise 2–3 hrs at room temp until it's puffy and jiggly.
  4. Heat the oven to 450°F. Oil your fingers and dimple all the way to the bottom of the pan.
  5. Press in the olives and rosemary, drizzle the last 2 tbsp oil, and shower with flaky salt.
  6. Bake 25–30 min until deep golden. Zest the lemon over the top right out of the oven.
  7. Cool 10 min on a rack so the bottom stays crisp.
Double it for family dinner. Dad always takes the corner pieces.

Ten days, one rental car, way too many arancine.

Cefalù

notes.title: Photography workflow for new team member
notes.html:
Photography workflow for new team member

For Kai and anyone else new at Northlight. This is the short version; the full guide is in Documents › Northlight.

1. Import
  • Copy, don't move. Card → working SSD + RAID at the same time
  • Folder name: YYMMDD_Client_Project
  • Apply the studio copyright preset + client keywords on import
  • Don't format a card until it's on two drives
2. Culling
  • First pass: flag picks only, fast. Don't zoom in yet
  • Second pass: compare similar frames side by side, check focus at 100%
  • Stars: 3 = client gallery, 4 = retouch, 5 = portfolio
3. Color
  • Start from the shoot's custom profile, white balance off the gray card frame
  • Sync settings across each lighting setup, then fine-tune hero shots
  • Skin and product color first, mood second
  • Soft-proof on the calibrated display before export
4. Delivery
  • Exports: full-res JPEG sRGB + web crops (1:1, 4:5)
  • File name: Client_Project_###
  • Upload to the client gallery, then send the link with a short note
  • Archive the RAWs + catalog to the RAID and cloud backup within a week

When in doubt, ask Pedro about client stuff and me about anything color.

notes.title: Sofia's student council debate
notes.html:
Sofia's student council debate

Talking points for Sofia, running for 6th grade class rep. The debate is next week, 2 min opening + Q&A.

Opening
“Hi, I'm Sofia. I want our school to feel like ours. Here are three things I'll actually get done.”

Three ideas
  1. Fix the water fountain by the gym and add a bottle-filling station
  2. Start a lunchtime garden club (Aunt Mia can bring seeds + starts from the community garden 🌱)
  3. A suggestion box that gets answered, with a monthly “You asked, we did” post on the bulletin board
If they ask…
  • How will you pay for it? The bottle station is a PTA request; the garden club needs almost nothing.
  • Why you? I already help run the recycling team and I show up.
  • What if the principal says no? Then I come back with a smaller version.
Delivery tips
  • Slow down, you know this
  • Pick three friendly faces and talk to them
  • Pause after each idea
  • End with one sentence: “Vote for Sofia, and let's make it ours.”
